worldContract.ledgerPolicy: Arrival receipts are historical facts; current living presence is evaluated separately. Selected service completion requires fresh authoritative final presence for each selected output and its unchanged original recipients.
worldContract.resourcePolicy: Operating stock, protected recovery, joint reservation escrow, committed expenditure, and finite optional reserve are distinct accounts. Only the complete selected recipe combination is reserved; no unselected recipe is charged.
worldContract.defeatPolicy: Known main defeat takes priority over same-batch victory. Loss of a required original recipient or generated selected result defeats; worker loss after its qualified work receipt does not erase that work.
worldContract.earlyDelivery: Initial placement never creates arrival or work receipts. Only fresh authoritative observation of the exact living identity at its declared destination records arrival.
worldContract.enemyBinding: No enemy identity or mobilization is authored; enemy production is disabled and any unspent roster remains in reserve.
